s.how: Press 500g pizza dough into an oiled tray. Spread a tin of crushed tomatoes with oregano right to the edges and top with 250g mozzarella and 100g pepperoni. Bake at 240C for 15 minutes and cut into squares.

s.note: Golden corn dogs with mustard and tomato sauce
s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

m.note: Butter thyme chicken with mushroom cream, gratin and beans
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Pan-roast 4 chicken breasts in 40g butter with thyme. Fry 250g mushrooms in the pan and add 150ml cream. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.note: Chocolate cupcakes topped with little chocolate mortarboards
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 175g self-raising flour, 30g cocoa and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Pipe vanilla buttercream from 150g butter and 300g icing sugar. Top with a square of chocolate and a lolly button.

d.note: Pineapple orange punch with lemonade, ladled from a bowl
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with lots of ice. Top with 750ml lemonade, float sliced oranges and set a ladle in it.

s.note: Crackling, scotch eggs and pickled onions on a pub board
s.how: Score 500g pork rind, salt and roast at 240C until blistered, then break up. Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, wrap each in 100g sausage mince, crumb in panko and fry at 170C for 7 minutes. Serve with pickled onions and English mustard.

s.note: Razor-straight cucumber and smoked salmon finger sandwiches
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with 150g cream cheese mixed with mint. Fill half with thin cucumber and half with 150g smoked salmon and dill butter. Trim the crusts and cut into perfectly straight fingers.

m.note: Smashed cheeseburgers served on the best china
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a smoking griddle and add American cheese. Mix mustard and tomato sauce. Stack two per soft bun with pickles and onion. Plate on fine china with silver cutlery and linen napkins. Manners maketh man.

w.note: Broken meringue, cream and macerated strawberries
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with 180g sugar to stiff peaks and bake in rough mounds at 100C for 90 minutes. Toss 500g sliced strawberries with sugar and lemon. Whip 400ml cream and fold through the broken meringue and berries.

d.note: Very dry gin martini with lemon peel
d.how: For each drink, stir 70ml gin over ice for 10 seconds and strain into a frozen glass. Look at the dry vermouth bottle, but never open it. Twist a strip of lemon peel over the top.

s.note: Cucumber dill rounds and smoked salmon rye on silver trays
s.how: Cut a cucumber into thick rounds and top with 150g cream cheese whipped with dill. Butter rye squares and top with 150g smoked salmon and a squeeze of lemon. Serve on silver trays at the garden party.

s.note: Ricotta crostini with crushed raspberries and honey
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast. Spread with 200g whipped ricotta. Top with 200g raspberries crushed with a little sugar and drizzle with honey.

m.note: Rich beef and pork lasagne rested before cutting
m.how: Simmer 500g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 tins tomatoes and red wine for 2 hours. Make béchamel with 50g butter, 50g flour and 600ml milk. Layer with 300g lasagne sheets and 250g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Rest 20 minutes.

w.note: Red velvet cupcakes with cream cheese frosting
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 200g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 200ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Pipe 250g cream cheese beaten with 250g icing sugar and add a red sugar dot.

d.note: Cherry lemonade slushie with a straw and spoon
d.how: Blend 500ml cherry juice with 300ml lemonade and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into tall cups with a straw and a spoon. How very.

s.note: Cheese puffs, pretzels and chocolate peanuts in plastic cups
s.how: Tip a bag of cheese puffs, 150g pretzels and 150g chocolate-coated peanuts into plastic cups. Line them up next to the speakers and refill every time the tape flips to side B.

s.note: Sticky purple blackberry soy glazed wings
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Simmer 150g blackberries with 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, a crushed garlic clove and chilli flakes until sticky, then strain. Toss the wings through.

m.note: Smoky barbecue ribs with corn and slaw
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 1 tbsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 150ml barbecue sauce and glaze under the grill. Serve with 4 grilled corn cobs and slaw.

w.note: Hot fudge sundaes with sprinkles and a sparkler
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate into 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, pour over the fudge, add whipped cream and rainbow sprinkles. Light a sparkler for the final move.

d.note: Layered red and blue nebula lemonade
d.how: Put a spoon of grenadine in the bottom of each of four glasses. Fill with ice and lemonade, then pour blue raspberry cordial slowly down a spoon so it layers like a nebula.

s.note: Two buckets: buttered popcorn and sweet soy kung fu popcorn
s.how: Pop 150g kernels in coconut oil. Toss half with 30g butter and fine salt. Toss the rest with 30g butter melted with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sugar. Serve in big paper buckets for the triple feature.

s.note: Warm cheddar and cayenne choux puffs
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs, 80g grated cheddar and a pinch of cayenne. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow.

m.note: Chicken club sandwiches with a silver bowl of fries
m.how: Grill 8 rashers bacon. Toast 12 slices white bread. Layer 300g roast chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo across three slices each and cut into triangles. Fry 1kg shoestring fries twice.

w.note: Lattice sour cherry pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 800g sour cherries with 150g sugar, lemon juice, a drop of almond extract and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: Salt-rimmed beach margaritas shaken with fresh lime, Cancún style
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a salt-rimmed glass. Makes four. You're so cool.

s.note: London landmark biscuits iced red and white
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll out and cut into London landmarks. Bake at 170C for 10 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, some tinted red.

s.note: Scone fingers with jam and clotted cream
s.how: Rub 60g cold butter into 350g self-raising flour, mix in 250ml milk lightly, pat out and cut into fingers. Glaze with milk and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with strawberry jam and clotted cream.

m.note: Creamy chicken, leek and mushroom pie under puff pastry
m.how: Cook 800g diced chicken thighs, 2 leeks and 250g mushrooms in 40g butter. Add 2 tbsp flour, 150ml white wine and 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Cool, top with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: Victoria sponge with jam, cream and pale pink icing
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 180C for 22 minutes. Fill with raspberry jam and 200ml whipped cream. Top with pale pink icing.

d.note: Strong brown pot tea with milk and two sugars
d.how: Brew 5 tea bags in a big brown pot with 1.2L boiling water for 4 minutes. Pour with milk and two sugars each, the way Knuckles likes it.

s.note: Smoked trout rye rounds and mini potato pancakes
s.how: Flake 150g hot-smoked trout onto rye rounds with horseradish cream. Grate 400g potatoes, squeeze dry and fry small pancakes. Top with sour cream and chives. Lay both on silver trays.

s.note: Prawn crackers puffed dramatically, with sweet chilli lime
s.how: Fry a few prawn crackers at a time at 190C for a few seconds until they puff up dramatically. Drain and serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.

m.note: Slow paprika beef goulash with crusty bread
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Cook 3 sliced onions slowly for 20 minutes, then add 2 tbsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp caraway and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 750ml water, return the beef and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Cinnamon walnut spit cakes filled with cream
w.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 50g sugar, 200ml warm milk, 60g butter and 1 egg and prove an hour. Wrap strips around foil-covered rolling pins, roll in cinnamon sugar and chopped walnuts and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Slide off and fill with 300ml whipped cream.

d.note: Cold Czech pilsner with a thick creamy head
d.how: Chill four 500ml bottles of Czech pilsner. Pour hard into heavy glasses so a thick, creamy head forms, then let it settle. This message will self-destruct.

s.n: Last crop corn on the cob
s.note: Charred corn with paprika lime butter and parmesan
s.how: Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes. Brush with 50g butter mixed with 1 tsp smoked paprika and lime zest, then char on a hot grill. Sprinkle with salt and 30g finely grated parmesan.

s.note: Smoky sweet popcorn dusted like the fields after a storm
s.how: Pop 120g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil. Toss straight away with 50g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp brown sugar until every kernel is dusted. Pour into bowls on the porch.

m.note: Creamy chicken, corn and leek pie under golden pastry
m.how: Poach 800g chicken thighs and shred. Soften a sliced leek in butter, add 2 tbsp flour, 200ml stock and 200ml cream, then the chicken, 200g corn kernels and thyme. Tip into a dish, top with 2 sheets shortcrust and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: Angled blue jelly with a whipped cream wave
w.how: Make 2 packets blue jelly crystals and pour into tall glasses tilted at an angle in a muffin tin. Set 3 hours, then stand them up. Whip 300ml cream with vanilla bean paste and pile high like a wave. Top with crushed shortbread.

d.note: Cold lager on the porch, or lemon iced tea
d.how: Chill four 375ml bottles of lager and frost four glasses in the freezer. For anyone not drinking, brew 4 black tea bags in 1L water, chill and pour over ice with lemon. Sit on the porch and watch the dust.

s.note: Olives, figs, honey feta, warm pita and golden haloumi
s.how: Griddle 250g sliced haloumi until golden and squeeze lemon over. Drizzle 150g feta with honey and thyme. Arrange on a big platter with olives, 4 halved figs and 4 warm pita breads.

s.note: Peppery beef and potato pasties with English mustard
s.how: Mix 300g beef mince with a diced potato and onion and plenty of pepper. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust into rounds, fill and fold into half moons. Crimp, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with English mustard.

m.note: Belgian beef and dark beer stew with frites
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Cook 3 sliced onions slowly, add 375ml dark beer, thyme, bay and 1 tbsp Dijon. Braise at 160C for 3 hours. Fry 1kg potatoes into frites, at 140C then 180C, and serve alongside.

w.note: Homemade vanilla ice cream in cones, a first taste
w.how: Warm 400ml cream and 300ml milk with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook to 82C. Chill overnight and churn. Scoop into 4 waffle cones and eat it fast, like it is the first ice cream ever.

d.note: Strong Belgian ale in stemmed glasses
d.how: Chill four 330ml bottles of strong Belgian ale lightly. Pour slowly into stemmed glasses, leaving a thick head. Sip it, it's stronger than it looks.

s.note: Curried devilled eggs with flecks of gold leaf
s.how: Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a pinch of curry powder until silky. Pipe back and finish each with a fleck of edible gold leaf.

s.note: Prawn cocktail in coupes with a brandy-spiked sauce
s.how: Poach 500g green prawns for 2 minutes, ice and peel. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish, lemon and a dash of brandy. Serve over shredded iceberg in coupes.

m.note: Sirloin with bourbon peppercorn cream and dripping potatoes
m.how: Roast 1kg potatoes in beef dripping or oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloins hard and rest. Deglaze with 60ml bourbon and crushed pepper, add 125ml stock and 200ml cream and reduce.

w.note: Dark chocolate truffles rolled until they shine gold
w.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Roll into balls, dust in cocoa, then roll in edible gold lustre until they shine.

d.note: Frosted bourbon mint juleps in metal cups, Kentucky style
d.how: For each drink, gently press 8 mint leaves with 15ml sugar syrup in a metal cup. Add 60ml bourbon, pack with crushed ice and stir until the cup frosts. Top with a big mint sprig. Makes four.

s.note: Garlic-rubbed ciabatta with salted tomato and basil
s.how: Toast slices of a ciabatta and rub with a cut garlic clove. Dice 4 ripe tomatoes, salt and leave 10 minutes. Mix with torn basil and 2 tbsp olive oil and pile on just before serving.

s.note: Puffed hollow gruyère choux with nutmeg
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs one at a time, then 80g grated gruyère and nutmeg. Pipe rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Bon appétit.

m.note: Beef braised in red wine with glazed pearl onions and mushrooms
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck and 150g bacon lardons. Add 2 carrots, an onion and garlic, then 750ml red wine, 250ml stock and herbs. Braise at 160C for 3 hours. Glaze 12 pearl onions and 250g mushrooms in butter and stir through.

w.note: Soft-centred chocolate almond cake with a chocolate glaze
w.how: Melt 125g dark chocolate with 100g butter. Beat 3 yolks with 100g sugar, add the chocolate, then fold in 60g almond meal and 30g flour. Fold in 3 whipped whites. Bake at 180C for 25 minutes. Glaze with 60g chocolate melted with butter.

d.note: Burgundy pinot noir, opened early and served just cool
d.how: Open a 750ml bottle of red Burgundy 30 minutes before dinner so it can breathe. Serve just below room temperature in big glasses, about 150ml each, and save a glass for the cook.

s.note: Charred corn wheels with lime chilli butter
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs over high heat until charred in rings. Cut into thick wheels and brush with 50g butter melted with lime zest and chilli flakes. Finish with flaky salt and coriander.

s.note: Brown butter parmesan popcorn in foil-lined bowls
s.how: Pop 120g kernels in a covered pot. Brown 50g butter until nutty and toss through with 40g grated parmesan and a little garlic powder. Serve in bowls lined with crumpled foil.

m.note: Slow-braised beef with vegetables and pan gravy
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg beef chuck hard. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 500ml stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Thicken the juices into gravy.

w.note: Double crust apple pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 1kg sliced Granny Smiths with 120g sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp flour. Line a dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill, cover with 2 more and egg wash. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and rest an hour. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: Half-full glasses of iced lemon water all over the table
d.how: Set out glasses of chilled water with ice and lemon slices all over the table, more than you need. Leave each one half full. Swing away.

s.note: Crisp potato skins with cheddar, bacon and sour cream
s.how: Bake 800g large potatoes at 200C for an hour. Halve, scoop and brush with 40g butter. Fill with 150g cheddar and 150g cooked bacon and bake until crisp. Top with sour cream and chives. Grown with care.

s.note: Smoky red capsicum hummus with warm flatbread
s.how: Roast a red capsicum until black, peel and seed. Blitz with a tin of chickpeas, 3 tbsp tahini, a garlic clove, lemon juice and 1 tsp smoked paprika until smooth. Swirl with olive oil and serve with warm flatbread.

m.note: Silky potato and leek soup with crisp bacon
m.how: Soften 2 leeks and an onion in 40g butter. Add 800g potatoes and 1.2L stock and simmer 25 minutes. Blend with 150ml cream until silky. Top with 150g crisp bacon and chives and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Hot fudge sundae with a cream rocket and honeycomb flames
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses and pour over the fudge. Pipe whipped cream into a tall rocket shape and scatter crushed honeycomb at the base for flames.

d.note: Strong coffee in big mugs for the night shift
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into big mugs, black for the night shift, with milk and raw sugar on the side.

s.note: Homemade pretzels with grainy mustard and butter
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm water and prove an hour. Shape 8 pretzels, dip in simmering water with 3 tbsp bicarb, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with grainy mustard and butter.

s.note: Peppery smoked paprika beef jerky for the long ride
s.how: Slice 500g partly frozen beef topside very thin. Marinate overnight in 60ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, cracked pepper and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Dry on racks at 70C for 4 hours.

m.note: Bratwurst with apple wine sauerkraut and buttered potatoes
m.how: Simmer a jar of sauerkraut with 125ml white wine, a grated apple and 1 tsp caraway for 20 minutes. Grill 8 bratwurst slowly until browned. Boil 800g potatoes and toss in butter.

w.note: Warm cinnamon peach cobbler under a buttery biscuit top, with cream
w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes and serve with cream.

d.note: Cold German lager in tall mugs with a thick head
d.how: Chill four 500ml bottles of German lager. Pour hard into tall mugs so a thick head forms. Raise them to a free man and a good dentist.

s.note: Fresh oysters on ice with mignonette and lemon
s.how: Finely dice 2 shallots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, then rest 20 minutes. Lay 24 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette.

s.note: Ham and mustard on crusty bread with buttered potatoes
s.how: Butter thick slices of a crusty loaf and fill with 300g ham and hot English mustard. Boil 600g small potatoes in their skins and toss with butter and salt. Serve together below deck.

m.note: Eye fillet with red wine shallot sauce, pommes Anna and beans
m.how: Layer 800g thinly sliced potatoes with 60g melted butter in a pan and bake at 200C for 50 minutes for pommes Anna. Tie 4 eye fillet steaks, sear in butter and roast to 54C. Reduce 2 shallots, 200ml red wine and 250ml stock for sauce. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.note: Baked apple and sultana custard with nutmeg
w.how: Cook 3 diced apples in 30g butter with 60g sultanas and tip into a dish. Whisk 3 eggs, 500ml milk and 60g sugar and pour over. Grate nutmeg on top and bake in a water bath at 160C for 40 minutes.

d.note: Stout left to settle, or lager for anyone dancing
d.how: Pour 500ml stout slowly into pint glasses and let it settle for a minute before topping up. For anyone dancing a jig below deck, pour a cold lager instead and keep the music going.

s.note: Caldo verde with kale and smoked sausage
s.how: Simmer 600g potatoes and an onion in 1.2L stock until soft, then mash smooth. Add a bunch of finely shredded kale and 200g sliced smoked sausage and simmer 5 minutes. Drizzle with olive oil.

s.note: Garlic butter parmesan dough knots, straight from the pizza parlour oven
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 12 ropes and tie each in a knot. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss straight away in 60g butter melted with 3 garlic cloves, chopped parsley and 30g parmesan.

m.note: Pizza with secret honey chilli tomato sauce and linguiça
m.how: Simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes with 2 garlic cloves, oregano, 1 tsp honey and a pinch of chilli for 20 minutes. Stretch 500g dough thin, spread with sauce, top with 250g mozzarella, 150g sliced linguiça and capsicum. Bake on a hot steel.

w.note: Blistered Portuguese custard tarts with cinnamon
w.how: Roll a sheet of puff pastry into a tight log, slice into 12 and press into a muffin tin. Whisk 4 yolks, 300ml cream, 100g sugar and lemon zest. Fill and bake at 250C for 12 minutes until blistered. Dust with cinnamon.

d.note: Light lager from an esky with a lemon wedge
d.how: Bury eight 355ml bottles of light lager in an esky of ice for an hour. Push a lemon wedge into the neck of each and hand them out at the harbour.

s.note: Smoked trout, cheddar, apple and pickles on a lodge board
s.how: Flake 150g hot-smoked trout onto a wooden board. Add crackers, 200g sharp cheddar, a sliced apple and pickled onions, the way a mountain lodge would set it out.

s.note: Garlic dill fridge pickles, ready in seven days
s.how: Slice 500g small cucumbers thin and pack into a jar with dill, 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over 250ml hot white vinegar boiled with 250ml water, 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tbsp salt. Refrigerate seven days before eating.

m.note: Miso honey glazed salmon with wild rice and broccolini
m.how: Mix 2 tbsp white miso, 1 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp soy and brush over 4 salmon fillets. Roast at 220C for 8 minutes. Cook 250g wild rice. Char 2 bunches broccolini in a hot pan.

w.note: Deep baked chocolate custard pots with a cream ring
w.how: Warm 300ml cream and 200ml milk, pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate and stir smooth. Whisk 4 yolks with 60g sugar and combine. Pour into 4 deep cups and bake in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes. Chill and pipe a ring of cream.

d.note: Strong pour-over coffee with hot milk
d.how: Grind 60g coffee. Pour 250ml water at 94C slowly over 15g grounds for each mug. Add a splash of hot milk. Drink it before the phone rings.

s.note: Dragon fruit, kiwi, pineapple and blueberry skewers
s.how: Cut a dragon fruit, 2 kiwifruit and a quarter pineapple into chunks and thread onto skewers with 125g blueberries. Drizzle with lime juice and honey and serve on a dark board under low light.

s.note: Soft star anise pork belly bao with pickled cucumber
s.how: Simmer 600g pork belly in 125ml soy, sliced ginger, 2 star anise and water for 2 hours, then slice. Steam 12 bao buns and fill with pork, pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.

m.note: Slow-roasted pulled lamb with flatbreads and herbs
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg lamb shoulder with 4 garlic cloves, rosemary and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Serve with 6 warm flatbreads and a salad of mint and parsley.

w.note: Coconut tapioca layered with mango and passionfruit
w.how: Simmer 100g tapioca pearls in 800ml coconut milk and 400ml water with 80g sugar for 15 minutes until clear. Chill. Layer in glasses with 2 diced mangoes and the pulp of 4 passionfruit, and top with toasted coconut.

d.note: Coconut pineapple cooler with a blue glow
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice. Pour in 150ml coconut water and 150ml pineapple juice each, then a splash of blue curaçao for the adults. Garnish with a pineapple wedge.

s.note: Apples, sharp cheddar, ham and crusty bread on a cloth
s.how: Lay a picnic cloth with 3 apples, a 250g wedge of sharp cheddar, a crusty loaf, 200g sliced ham and a dish of butter. Tear and slice as you go, between bicycle rides.

s.note: Red pretzel dynamite sticks with liquorice fuses
s.how: Melt 200g red candy melts. Dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way and push a short piece of liquorice strap into the top of each as a fuse. Set on baking paper for 20 minutes.

m.note: Dried chilli braised beef with a skillet of cornbread
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 4 soaked and blitzed dried chillies, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves and a tin of tomatoes. Braise 3 hours. Bake cornbread from 150g cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and egg alongside.

w.note: Lemon drizzle loaf with thin lemon icing
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs and lemon zest, and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 45 minutes. Soak with hot lemon syrup, then top with 100g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.

d.note: Neat bourbon with a beer chaser for the gang
d.how: Pour 45ml bourbon neat into each of four small glasses and set them on the bar. Serve a cold lager alongside as a chaser for anyone riding with the Hole-in-the-Wall gang tonight.

s.note: Venetian bar toasts of salt cod, prosciutto fig and sardines
s.how: Poach 200g smoked cod in milk, flake and beat with a boiled potato and olive oil. Toast 12 baguette slices. Top four with the cod and parsley, four with prosciutto and fig, and four with sardines, onion and raisins.

s.note: Homemade pretzels with paprika camembert dip
s.how: Make 8 pretzels from 400g flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm water, dip in bicarb water, salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mash 200g ripe camembert with 50g butter, 1 tsp paprika and a little onion for obatzda.

m.note: Golden puffy schnitzel with warm potato salad
m.how: Pound 4 pork schnitzels thin. Crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g panko and fry in butter and oil until golden and puffy. Toss 800g warm boiled potatoes with vinegar, oil and onion. Serve with cucumber salad and lemon.

w.note: Rosewater syrup almond pistachio cake topped with rose petals
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 200g sugar, fold in 200g almond meal and 100g ground pistachios. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Simmer 100g sugar, lemon juice and 2 tsp rosewater and pour over. Top with crushed pistachios and rose petals.

d.note: Wine in plain cups, one gold goblet nobody drinks from
d.how: Pour red wine or red grape juice into plain wooden or clay cups. Put one fancy gold goblet in the middle and don't let anyone drink from it. Choose wisely.

s.note: Egg salad sandwiches and apple slices on a blanket
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes and mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chives and white pepper. Spread on 8 slices soft white bread and cut into triangles. Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon. Lay it out on a picnic blanket.

s.note: Warm Cajun boiled peanuts in paper cones
s.how: Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell for 2 hours in water with 80g salt and 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning. Soak an hour off the heat, drain and serve warm in paper cones.

m.note: Cajun roast whole fish with hush puppies and slaw
m.how: Score a 1.5kg whole snapper and rub with Cajun seasoning and 50g butter. Roast at 200C for 25 minutes. Fry hush puppies of 150g cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and egg. Shred a quarter cabbage for slaw. Serve with lemon.

w.note: Bright yellow-iced lemon drizzle cake, like a field of daffodils
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs and lemon zest and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Bake at 170C for 45 minutes. Soak with hot lemon syrup, then ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice and a touch of yellow.

d.note: Frosty mint lemonade in a big jug
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water in a big jug. Add a handful of bruised mint and plenty of ice and stir until frosty.

s.note: Twisted Jersey doughnuts dusted with sugar
s.how: Rub 50g butter into 250g flour, add 50g sugar and 2 eggs and knead. Rest an hour, roll out, cut strips, slit and twist through. Fry at 175C until golden and dust with sugar and nutmeg.

s.note: Lemony crab piled on buttered toast
s.how: Fold 250g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, chives and a pinch of cayenne. Toast 4 slices white bread, butter and cut into fingers. Pile the crab on top.

m.note: Minted buttered new potatoes with brown butter fish
m.how: Boil 800g new potatoes with mint and toss in salted butter. Pan-fry 4 white fish fillets until golden. Brown 60g butter, add 1 tbsp capers and lemon juice, and spoon over the fish.

w.note: Slow-baked creamy vanilla rice pudding with nutmeg
w.how: Put 100g short grain rice, 800ml milk, 200ml cream, 70g sugar and a split vanilla bean in a dish. Bake at 150C for 2 hours, stirring twice. Grate nutmeg on top. Serve warm, curtains drawn.

d.note: Breakfast tea from a warmed pot on a tray
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Serve on a tray with milk and sugar. Keep the curtains closed.

s.note: Smoked trout cream cheese on rye crispbread
s.how: Flake 150g smoked trout into 150g cream cheese with dill and lemon juice. Spread on 12 rye crispbreads and top with slices of pickled onion.

s.note: Two rival sliders, beef cheddar and pork apple sage
s.how: Make 6 beef sliders from 300g mince with cheddar and pickles, and 6 pork sliders from 300g mince with grated apple and sage. Serve side by side in 12 slider buns so both families get their own.

m.note: Stout and juniper beef stew with buttered mash
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 6 crushed juniper berries and 375ml stout. Simmer covered for 3 hours until it falls apart. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter.

w.note: Gingerbread envelopes piped white with a red seal
w.how: Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir in 300g flour, 2 tsp ginger and 1 tsp cinnamon. Chill, roll and cut into envelopes. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Pipe with white icing and add a red seal.

d.note: Cinnamon hot chocolate with marshmallows for a frozen island night
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until frothy. Pour into four mugs and top with marshmallows. A true selfless act always sparks another.

s.note: A block of cheddar on ice, chopped rough at the table
s.how: Set a 500g block of sharp cheddar on a bed of crushed ice. Cut into rough chunks at the table with a big knife. Serve with crackers and pickled onions.

s.note: Sticky smoky drumsticks eaten with your hands
s.how: Rub 1kg chicken drumsticks with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes, brushing with barbecue sauce for the last 10, until sticky.

m.note: Smashed double cheeseburgers with crinkle fries
m.how: Smash 8 thin patties from 800g chuck mince on a hot griddle and add American cheese. Stack two per toasted bun with pickles, onion and burger sauce. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.note: Honey yoghurt bark with berries and pistachios
w.how: Mix 500g Greek yoghurt with 3 tbsp honey and vanilla. Spread thin on a lined tray, scatter with 150g mixed berries and 40g crushed pistachios. Freeze 4 hours and break into shards.

d.note: Thick banana, mango and orange smoothie, California style
d.how: Blend 2 bananas, 1 mango, 500ml orange juice and a cup of ice until thick. Pour into four tall cups with straws. Wheez the juice.

s.note: Figure-eight soft pretzels with butter and mustard
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm water and prove an hour. Shape 8 figure eights, dip in simmering water with 3 tbsp bicarb and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with mustard.

s.note: Chocolate strawberries rolled in bright red raspberry dust
s.how: Dip 500g dry strawberries in 150g melted dark chocolate. Before it sets, roll half of each in crushed freeze-dried raspberries so they're bright red. Chill on baking paper until set.

m.note: Salmon with beurre blanc, crushed potatoes and asparagus
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Reduce a shallot with 100ml white wine, then whisk in 120g cold butter cube by cube. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Steam 2 bunches asparagus.

w.note: Pale white chocolate mousse with a few raspberries on top
w.how: Melt 150g white chocolate into 100ml warm cream and cool. Fold through 200ml whipped cream and 1 whisked egg white. Spoon into glasses and set 4 hours. Top with a few raspberries.

d.note: Frothy dark hot chocolate with marshmallows for a cold room
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g dark chocolate until frothy. Pour into four mugs and top with marshmallows. Drink it while it's warm, the room gets cold.

s.note: Salmon and tuna nigiri with wasabi, ginger and soy
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt. Shape into fingers with a touch of wasabi under each. Top with slices of 150g salmon and 150g tuna. Serve with pickled ginger and soy.

s.note: Warm olives with preserved lemon, cumin and harissa
s.how: Warm 150g green and 150g black olives in 3 tbsp olive oil with chopped preserved lemon rind, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp harissa and a sliced garlic clove for 10 minutes. Cool slightly and serve with flatbreads.

m.note: Slow lamb tagine with dates, preserved lemon and almond couscous
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder. Soften 2 onions, add 2 tbsp ras el hanout and 500ml stock. Add 8 medjool dates and a sliced preserved lemon and cook covered at 160C for 3 hours. Serve over 300g couscous with toasted almonds.

w.note: Syrup-soaked semolina almond cake with orange blossom
w.how: Mix 200g semolina, 100g almond meal, 250g Greek yoghurt, 200g sugar and 1 tsp baking powder. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Pour over hot syrup of 150g sugar, 150ml water and 1 tbsp orange blossom water. Top with flaked almonds.

d.note: Sweet mint tea poured from a height
d.how: Steep 2 tbsp gunpowder green tea and a big handful of mint in 1L boiling water with 4 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes. Pour from a height into little glasses so it froths.

s.note: Puffy golden clam fritters with lemon and tartare
s.how: Drain a tin of chopped clams, keeping the juice. Mix 200g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 150ml clam juice and fold in the clams. Spoon into 180C oil and fry until puffed and golden. Serve with lemon and tartare.

s.note: Crisp-edged cornmeal griddle cakes with butter and maple
s.how: Pour 300ml boiling water over 200g fine cornmeal and a pinch of salt and stir. Loosen with 100ml milk. Cook spoonfuls in butter on a griddle until crisp at the edges. Serve with butter and maple syrup.

m.note: Cod baked under buttery cracker crumbs with peas and potatoes
m.how: Lay 4 cod fillets in a dish. Crush 100g crackers with 60g melted butter, lemon zest and parsley and press on top. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Serve with 800g boiled potatoes and 300g buttered peas.

w.note: Cinnamon apple crisp with an oat crumble and cream
w.how: Toss 6 sliced apples with 1 tsp cinnamon, 60g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 80g flour, 80g oats and 80g brown sugar. Scatter over and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve with pouring cream.

d.note: Rhode Island coffee milk over ice
d.how: Brew 50g coffee with 400ml water, then simmer with 150g sugar until syrupy and cool. Stir 3 tbsp into each tall glass of cold milk over ice.

s.note: Crisp hot sauce party wings with blue cheese dip and celery
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter. Mix 80g blue cheese into 150g sour cream to dip and serve with celery sticks.

s.note: Smashed cheddar sliders with pickles and mustard mayo
s.how: Smash 12 small patties from 500g beef mince on a hot grill and melt cheddar on each. Mix 100g mayo with 1 tbsp mustard. Build in 12 slider buns with pickles, sliced onion and the mustard mayo.

m.note: Chicken parmigiana with ham, napoli and mozzarella, chips and salad
m.how: Halve 2 chicken breasts, crumb in flour, 2 eggs and 150g panko and fry until golden. Top with 250ml napoli sauce, 4 slices ham and 200g mozzarella and grill until bubbling. Fry 1kg potato chips twice and serve with a green salad.

w.note: Warm lattice apple pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Cook 1kg sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes and cool. Line a dish with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream.

d.note: Frothy espresso mochaccino with cream and grated chocolate
d.how: Brew 4 espressos with 72g ground coffee. Whisk 2 tbsp cocoa into 600ml hot milk until frothy. Pour the coffee into four mugs, top with the chocolate milk, whipped cream and grated dark chocolate.

s.note: Spiced beef tacos in warm corn tortillas with salsa
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with an onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and chilli. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with the beef, shredded lettuce, 100g grated cheddar and a spoon of salsa.

s.note: Double-fried fries smothered in chilli and melted cheddar
s.how: Brown 300g beef mince with a chopped onion and chilli powder, add a drained tin of kidney beans and a splash of water and simmer 20 minutes. Fry 1kg thick chips twice. Spoon the chilli over, top with 150g cheddar and grill to melt.

m.note: Chilli dogs with mustard, raw onion and relish
m.how: Simmer 250g beef mince with 1 tsp cumin, chilli powder and 150ml water for 20 minutes until loose. Griddle 8 franks and put in steamed buns. Top with the chilli, yellow mustard, raw onion and sweet relish.

w.note: Orange juice ice blocks with frozen berries inside
w.how: Stir 2 tbsp sugar into 500ml fresh orange juice until dissolved. Drop a few frozen berries into each mould and pour the juice over. Push sticks in after an hour and freeze solid for 6 hours.

d.note: Cola over ice with lime, sipped in the shade
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice and a squeeze of lime. Pour a 375ml can of cola over each and drink it in the shade between cars.

s.note: Buttered stovetop popcorn, never left alone in the kitchen
s.how: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a heavy covered pot over medium heat with 3 kernels. When they pop, add 120g kernels and shake constantly. Pull it off the second the popping slows. Toss with 50g melted butter and salt.

s.note: Devilled eggs, sticky cocktail franks and cream cheese celery boats
s.how: Boil 6 eggs, halve and pipe with yolks whipped with mayo and paprika. Simmer 16 cocktail franks in 100ml barbecue sauce with a spoon of grape jelly until sticky. Fill celery boats with cream cheese and sliced olives.

m.note: Creamy baked chicken, mushroom and rice casserole
m.how: Brown 800g chicken thighs and set aside. Soften 250g mushrooms, stir in 250g long grain rice, 500ml stock, 150ml cream and thyme. Lay the chicken on top, cover and bake at 180C for 50 minutes.

w.note: Vanilla bean cupcakes with white meringue buttercream and pink roses
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites with 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter and pipe white. Add a tiny pink sugar rose.

d.note: Sweet iced tea with lemon and mint over ice
d.how: Brew 6 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 5 minutes and stir in 80g sugar while hot. Cool completely. Pour over ice in four glasses with lemon slices and mint.

s.note: Chilli pineapple pork tacos, LA truck style
s.how: Blitz 3 soaked dried chillies with the juice of an orange and 100g pineapple and marinate 800g sliced pork shoulder for 4 hours. Roast at 200C for 30 minutes, then slice and crisp in a pan. Serve in 16 corn tortillas with pineapple, onion and coriander.

s.note: Fresh oysters on ice with mignonette and lemon
s.how: Finely dice 2 shallots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, then rest 20 minutes. Lay 24 freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette alongside.

m.note: Spaghetti with a slow three-hour beef and pork ragù
m.how: Brown 400g beef mince and 300g pork mince. Add 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 200ml red wine and simmer gently for 3 hours, topping up with water. Toss with 500g spaghetti and grate 60g parmesan over.

w.note: Baked New York cheesecake, cooled slowly in the oven
w.how: Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for an hour and cool in the oven. Chill overnight.

d.note: Strong black drip coffee, refilled without asking
d.how: Brew 70g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine so it's strong. Pour black into heavy diner mugs and refill without asking, all night.

s.note: Spiced baked snack mix bagged like evidence
s.how: Toss 100g corn chips, 100g pretzels and 100g cheese crackers with 50g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and half a tsp garlic powder. Bake at 150C for 20 minutes. Tip into paper bags labelled like evidence.

s.note: Smoky charred eggplant dip with flatbread
s.how: Char 2 eggplants whole over a gas flame until collapsed. Scoop out and blend with 3 tbsp tahini, a garlic clove, lemon juice and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Serve with warm flatbreads.

m.note: Beef and pork lasagne, rested before cutting
m.how: Simmer 500g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 tins tomatoes and 150ml red wine for 2 hours. Make béchamel with 50g butter, 50g flour and 600ml milk. Layer with 300g lasagne sheets and 250g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Rest 20.

w.note: Lattice sour cherry pie with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 800g sour cherries with 150g sugar, lemon juice and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: Frothy cinnamon hot chocolate for a night with the lights on
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until frothy. Pour into four mugs and leave the night light on.

s.note: Twelve perfect devilled egg halves with paprika
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a dash of vinegar. Pipe back into the whites, dust with paprika and add chives. Exactly twelve.

s.note: Jerky, peanuts, chips and sour lollies along the bench
s.how: Tip 100g beef jerky, 150g salted peanuts, a bag of potato chips and 200g sour lollies into bowls and line them up along the bench like the shop counter. I'm not even supposed to be here today.

m.note: Loaded salami, ham and provolone hoagies
m.how: Split 4 long bread rolls. Layer with 150g salami, 150g ham, 100g provolone, shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and onion. Drizzle with olive oil and red wine vinegar, sprinkle with oregano, wrap tight and cut in half.

w.note: Soft cake cookies iced half vanilla, half chocolate
w.how: Beat 115g butter with 150g sugar and 1 egg, then fold in 250g self-raising flour and 125ml buttermilk. Scoop 8 large mounds and bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Ice the flat sides half with vanilla glaze and half with glaze mixed with cocoa.

d.note: Malted chocolate milk shaken with ice, or plain cold milk
d.how: For each glass, shake 250ml cold milk with 1 tbsp cocoa, 1 tbsp malted milk powder and a few ice cubes until frothy. Or just drink the milk cold straight from the carton.

s.note: Steamed pork and prawn siu mai with chilli oil
s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, 1 tbsp grated ginger, 50g chopped shiitake and soy. Spoon into 24 wonton wrappers, pinch up the sides and steam 8 minutes. Serve with chilli oil.

s.note: Crisp vegetable spring rolls with sweet chilli
s.how: Stir-fry 2 cups shredded wombok, a grated carrot and 100g sliced shiitake. Add 50g soaked glass noodles and soy, then cool. Roll tight in 16 spring roll wrappers and fry at 180C until golden. Serve with sweet chilli.

m.note: Sticky char siu pork over egg fried rice
m.how: Marinate 800g pork neck overnight in 4 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp five spice and 2 tbsp Shaoxing. Roast at 200C for 35 minutes, glazing twice. Fry 300g cooked jasmine rice with 2 eggs and spring onion. Slice the pork over.

w.note: Thin crêpes wrapped around cream and fresh mango
w.how: Whisk 120g flour, 2 eggs, 300ml milk and 2 tbsp sugar and rest. Cook 8 thin crêpes in a non-stick pan and cool. Wrap each around whipped cream from 300ml and a thick slice of mango from 2 mangoes. Fold into parcels and chill an hour.

d.note: Lightly sweet chrysanthemum tea, warm or iced
d.how: Steep 15g dried chrysanthemum flowers in 1L hot water with 50g rock sugar for 5 minutes. Strain and serve warm, or chill and pour over ice. Boards don't hit back.

s.note: Grape jellies topped with cream like bottle caps
s.how: Soak 6 gelatine leaves. Warm 500ml grape juice with 2 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon and stir in the gelatine. Set in small round moulds for 3 hours. Turn out and top each with a dot of whipped cream.

s.note: Trail mix in paper bags with hand-drawn badges
s.how: Toss 150g peanuts, 100g raisins, 80g choc chips, 100g pretzels and 80g banana chips together. Scoop into paper bags and draw a badge on each one. Adventure is out there.

m.note: Roast sirloin with red wine sauce, potatoes and buttered beans
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg sirloin at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml stock and whisk in a knob of butter. Steam 300g green beans and toss in butter.

w.note: Dark chocolate bark with hazelnuts, cherries and salt
w.how: Melt 300g dark chocolate and spread thin on a lined tray. Scatter with 60g toasted hazelnuts, 60g dried cherries and flaky salt. Set and break into shards. Save some for the bird.

d.note: Grape juice and soda over ice with lime
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice. Pour 150ml grape juice into each and top with soda water. Add a squeeze of lime and hand them out with a grape soda badge.

s.note: Spiced nut and pretzel mix with jerky strips
s.how: Toss 150g pretzels, 150g salted peanuts and 100g cashews with 40g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Roast at 160C for 15 minutes and cool. Tip into paper bags with strips of 100g beef jerky.

s.note: Shattering double-fried wings in gochujang honey glaze
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch and fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest, then fry at 190C until shattering. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp honey and garlic until glossy. Toss and top with sesame.

m.note: Seared citrus skirt steak tacos with salsa roja
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak in lime, orange, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 2 hours. Sear over very high heat, rest and slice against the grain. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and a jar of salsa roja.

w.note: Golden baked coconut tart in sweet pastry
w.how: Blind-bake a tart tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk 200g desiccated coconut, 3 eggs, 150g sugar, 80g melted butter and 200ml coconut milk. Pour in and bake at 170C for 30 minutes until golden and set.

d.note: Drip coffee in lidded paper cups for the cup holder
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into paper cups with milk and sugar, put the lids on and set them in the cup holder for the night.

s.note: Devilled eggs, ham pineapple picks and cucumber rounds
s.how: Boil 6 eggs, halve and pipe with yolks whipped with mayo and paprika. Thread 150g diced ham and a quarter pineapple onto toothpicks. Pipe 150g cream cheese with chives onto cucumber rounds. Serve on silver trays.

s.note: Radish roses and vegetable bunches with ranch dip
s.how: Cut radishes into roses and bunch cucumber and carrot batons like a corsage. Mix 100ml buttermilk, 150g sour cream, a crushed garlic clove, dill and chives for ranch.

m.note: Chicken in mushroom white wine cream with mash and beans
m.how: Brown 4 chicken breasts in butter and finish in a 200C oven. Fry 250g mushrooms in the pan, add 150ml white wine and 150ml cream and reduce. Mash 1kg potatoes. Steam 300g green beans and toss with butter.

w.note: Strawberry cream layer cake in pale pink with a sugar crown
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill with 250g sliced strawberries and 200ml whipped cream. Cover in pink buttercream of 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and mashed strawberry.

d.note: Pineapple lemonade punch with fruit and a frozen juice ring
d.how: Freeze 500ml pineapple juice in a ring tin overnight. Put it in a big glass bowl and pour over 1.25L lemonade and 250ml more pineapple juice. Add sliced strawberries and orange.

s.note: Nachos arranged in a V formation on the tray
s.how: Arrange a 300g bag of corn chips in a V on a tray. Layer with a drained tin of black beans, 200g cheddar and jalapeños. Bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Top with diced tomato and 150g sour cream. Quack, quack, quack.

s.note: Little round cheese sliders on black sesame buns
s.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 thick little rounds and griddle. Melt cheddar on top and put in 12 slider buns brushed with butter and sprinkled with black sesame seeds, with pickles.

m.note: Beef, corn and bean bake under crisp potato gems
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince with an onion and 200g mushrooms. Stir in 200g corn, 200g chopped green beans and 250ml cream. Tip into a dish, cover with 500g potato gems and bake at 200C for 35 minutes.

w.note: Brownies under smooth white chocolate ice
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs and fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Spread 150g melted white chocolate smooth over the top like ice and cut into squares.

d.note: Rinkside hot chocolate topped with marshmallows
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until frothy. Pour into big mugs and pile marshmallows on top. Ducks fly together.

s.note: Steamed pork and cabbage dumplings in bamboo baskets
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 spring onions. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes in bamboo baskets. Serve with black vinegar and chilli oil.

s.note: Cumin and chilli lamb skewers charred over high heat
s.how: Toss 600g diced lamb shoulder with 2 tsp crushed cumin seeds, 1 tsp chilli flakes and flaky salt. Thread onto skewers and grill hot until charred at the edges. Sprinkle with more cumin to serve.

m.note: Steamed whole snapper with ginger, spring onion and sizzling oil
m.how: Score a 1.2kg whole snapper and lay on sliced ginger and spring onion. Steam for 12 minutes. Pile fresh shredded spring onion and coriander on top, pour over 3 tbsp soy, then 4 tbsp smoking hot oil so it sizzles.

w.note: Puffed golden sesame balls filled with red bean
w.how: Mix 250g glutinous rice flour and 60g sugar with about 200ml hot water into a dough. Wrap around small balls of red bean paste, roll in sesame seeds and fry at 160C until puffed and golden.

d.note: Gentle green tea refilled through the meal
d.how: Heat 1L water to about 80C. Steep 4 tsp green tea leaves for 2 minutes, then pour into small cups. Refill the pot and keep the cups topped up through the meal.

s.note: Fish-shaped peanut butter and honey sandwiches
s.how: Spread 8 slices soft white bread with smooth peanut butter and a little honey. Sandwich, cut off the crusts and cut into fish shapes with a cutter. Feed one to the fish.

s.note: Tuna poke on crisp rice crackers
s.how: Dice 300g sashimi tuna and toss with 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, sliced spring onion and a little chilli. Spoon onto rice crackers and serve straight away.

m.note: Burger patties on rice with onion gravy and a runny egg
m.how: Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and sear in a hot pan. Cook 300g jasmine rice. In the same pan, soften a sliced onion in 30g butter, stir in a spoon of flour and 400ml stock until thick. Serve patties on rice with gravy and a fried egg.

w.note: Thick pineapple coconut soft serve, piped and eaten fast
w.how: Blitz 500g frozen pineapple with 100ml coconut cream, a squeeze of lime and a spoon of sugar until thick and smooth. Pipe into cups and serve straight away before it melts.

d.note: Blue pineapple coconut slushie with a pineapple wedge
d.how: Blend 500ml pineapple juice, 150ml coconut cream, 60ml blue raspberry cordial and 3 cups ice until slushy. Pour into four tall glasses with a pineapple wedge. Ohana means family.

s.note: Crisp honey hot sauce wings with blue cheese
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter and 1 tbsp honey. Serve with 80g blue cheese mashed into 150g sour cream and celery sticks.

s.note: Beer-battered fish tacos with lime crema and pico
s.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with lime. Serve in 12 warm tortillas with shredded cabbage, diced tomato and onion.

m.note: Lemon oregano chicken with Greek salad and warm pita
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in lemon, 3 garlic cloves and oregano for an hour and grill until charred. Toss tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and 150g feta for a Greek salad. Serve with 4 warm pita.

w.note: Glossy glazed brownies cut into rectangles
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cut into rectangles and drizzle with 80g chocolate melted with a knob of butter.

d.note: Ice-cold lager poured into glasses frosted in the freezer
d.how: Put four glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes until frosted. Chill eight 355ml bottles of American lager. Pour into the frosted glasses. I feel the need for a cold one.

s.note: Lemon mayo chicken rolls with avocado and cos
s.how: Tear 300g roast chicken and mix with 3 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Pile into 4 soft rolls with sliced avocado and crisp cos. Wrap tight in paper for the boat.

s.note: Crisp cornmeal calamari with tartare and lemon
s.how: Cut 500g calamari into strips and soak in 200ml buttermilk. Dredge in 100g cornmeal and 50g flour and fry at 185C for 90 seconds. Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.

m.note: Clams, prawns, potatoes, corn and sausage tipped onto the table
m.how: Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 200g sliced smoked sausage, 60g butter and a splash of water, then 1kg clams and 500g prawns. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

w.note: Lemony blueberry cobbler with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 500g blueberries with 80g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Esky lagers on deck, lemonade for the young crew
d.how: Bury eight 375ml bottles of light lager and a 1.25L bottle of lemonade in an esky of ice and water for an hour. Crack them open on deck. Just when you thought it was safe.

s.note: Honey lime melon and pear that seems to hover
s.how: Cut 2 pears, a quarter rockmelon and a quarter honeydew into cubes and spear on toothpicks. Drizzle with honey and lime. Arrange on a long platter so they look like they're hovering.

s.note: Fiery red chilli honey glazed wings
s.how: Bake 1kg chicken wings at 220C for 45 minutes. Melt 3 tbsp chilli sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 40g butter and toss through. Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onion.

m.note: Patty melts on rye with crinkle fries and a pickle
m.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly until golden. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin patties and sear. Layer on 8 slices rye with the onions and 4 slices Swiss, butter the outside and grill until melted. Fry 1kg crinkle-cut potatoes twice.

w.note: White chocolate mousse with a dark chocolate square
w.how: Melt 150g white chocolate into 100ml warm cream and cool. Fold through 200ml whipped cream and a whisked egg white. Set in 4 glasses for 4 hours. Top with whipped cream and a thin square of dark chocolate.

d.note: Strong drip coffee with hot milk and raw sugar
d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine so it comes out strong. Pour into thick diner mugs and serve with hot milk and raw sugar on the side, the way Dex runs his counter.

s.note: Pleated pork and prawn dumplings with soy and vinegar
s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, grated ginger and spring onion. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes. Serve with soy and black vinegar.

s.note: Cast iron cornbread with honey butter
s.how: Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 220C oven. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter briefly. Pour in and bake 20 minutes. Serve with 60g butter beaten with honey.

m.note: Five spice ribs with a hoisin honey glaze
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 2 tsp five spice, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 garlic cloves and salt. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 4 tbsp hoisin mixed with 2 tbsp honey and glaze under the grill.

w.note: Almond cookies beside wedges of cinnamon apple pie
w.how: Bake 16 almond cookies from 125g butter, 120g sugar, 120g almond meal and 120g flour at 170C for 14 minutes. Bake an apple pie of 800g apples with cinnamon in 4 sheets sweet shortcrust at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve together.

d.note: Neat rye whisky, jasmine tea for anyone sitting out
d.how: Pour 45ml rye whisky neat into small glasses. Brew a pot of jasmine tea for anyone sitting it out, and pour both at the same time.

s.note: Big chunks of tropical fruit on banana leaves
s.how: Cut 3 bananas, 2 mangoes, a quarter pineapple and half a papaya into big chunks. Pile on banana leaves with the pulp of 2 passionfruit, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of chilli salt.

s.note: Crunchy curry honey roasted chickpeas and cashews
s.how: Drain and dry 2 tins chickpeas. Toss with 150g cashews, 2 tbsp oil, 2 tsp curry powder and 1 tbsp honey. Roast at 180C for 25 minutes until crunchy and tip out messily on a board.

m.note: Coconut chicken curry with rice and mango chutney
m.how: Soften an onion with ginger, garlic and 2 tbsp curry powder. Add 1kg diced chicken thighs, a tin of tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 40 minutes. Serve with 300g basmati rice and mango chutney.

w.note: Cinnamon sugar banana fritters with honey
w.how: Whisk 150g flour with 200ml sparkling water. Dip thick slices of 4 bananas and fry at 180C until puffed. Roll in 80g sugar with cinnamon and drizzle with honey.

d.note: Proper tea in cups, the way Jane would serve it
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and 1L freshly boiled water and brew 4 minutes. Pour into proper cups with milk and sugar on the tray.

s.note: Crisp oatcakes with sharp cheddar and apple chutney
s.how: Mix 200g oats with 50g melted butter, salt and a splash of hot water. Roll thin, cut rounds and bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Serve with 200g sharp cheddar and apple chutney.

s.note: Smoked salmon on brown bread with lemon butter
s.how: Mash 50g soft butter with lemon zest. Spread on 6 slices wholemeal bread and top with 200g smoked salmon, dill and capers. Cut into neat squares.

m.note: Lamb neck broth with barley, split peas and root veg
m.how: Simmer 1kg lamb neck in 2.5L water with 100g pearl barley and 100g split peas for an hour. Add 2 leeks, 2 carrots and a diced swede and simmer another hour. Pull the meat back in and finish with parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Proper buttery Scottish shortbread, cut warm and sugared on top
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 110g caster sugar, then work in 300g flour and 60g rice flour. Press into a tin, prick and bake at 150C for 40 minutes. Cut while warm and sprinkle with caster sugar.

d.note: Scotch with a jug of water for a few drops
d.how: Pour 30ml Scotch whisky into each of four small glasses. Put a jug of cold water on the side so everyone can add a few drops. Raise it to freedom.

s.note: Roasted peanuts, pickled onions and cheddar on the porch
s.how: Roast 400g peanuts in the shell at 180C for 20 minutes and salt while hot. Lay out on an old tray with pickled onions, a wedge of 200g sharp cheddar and crackers for the porch.

s.note: Fresh blueberry muffins with a cinnamon crumble top, Maine style
s.how: Mix 300g flour, 150g sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 80g melted butter and 1 egg briefly. Fold in 200g blueberries. Spoon into a 12-hole tin, top with cinnamon crumble and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

m.note: Slow-braised beef with vegetables, Maine style
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg beef chuck hard. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 500ml stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour.

w.note: Cinnamon apple crisp with an oat crumble and cream
w.how: Toss 6 sliced apples with 1 tsp cinnamon, 60g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 80g flour, 80g oats and 80g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve with pouring cream.

d.note: Cold lager on the porch as the trucks go by
d.how: Chill eight 355ml bottles of American lager. Crack them open on the porch and drink from the bottle, keeping well back from the road as the trucks go by.

s.note: Blistered za'atar flatbreads with hummus, pickled turnips and olives
s.how: Brush 4 flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar. Grill until blistered at the edges. Cut into wedges and serve with a tub of hummus, pickled turnips and kalamata olives in little bowls.

s.note: Charred garlic chilli lime prawn skewers with mango salsa
s.how: Toss 600g peeled green prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, a chopped chilli and the juice of a lime and marinate 20 minutes. Thread onto skewers and grill until pink and charred. Dice a mango with coriander and lime for salsa.

m.note: Stout-braised beef with carrots over buttery mash
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, thyme and 375ml stout and simmer covered for 3 hours until tender. Ladle over 1kg potatoes mashed with 60g butter. Rain on the windows optional.

w.note: Glossy dark chocolate mousse domes with one little dent
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate, whisk in 2 yolks, then fold in 2 whites whipped with 40g sugar and 150ml whipped cream. Set in 4 round moulds overnight. Turn out and glaze with 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream and a little cocoa. Press a dent in each.

d.note: Ginger honey green tea, hot or iced
d.how: Steep 4 tsp green tea with a sliced knob of ginger in 1L water at about 80C for 3 minutes. Strain and stir in 2 tbsp honey. Serve hot in small cups, or chill and pour over ice. I am one with the Force.

s.note: Crustless cucumber and ham mustard sandwiches in triangles
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread. Fill half with thin cucumber and half with 150g ham and English mustard. Cut off the crusts and cut into triangles for a proper English touch on a New Mexico ranch.

s.note: Hot cheese dip with roasted green chillies and chips
s.how: Roast 3 green chillies until blackened, peel and chop. Warm 375ml evaporated milk with a crushed garlic clove, stir in 250g grated cheddar until smooth, then add the chillies. Serve hot with a 300g bag of corn chips.

m.note: Pork shoulder braised with green chillies and tomatillos over rice
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced pork shoulder. Char 4 green chillies and 400g tomatillos, then blitz with an onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin. Braise the pork in the sauce for 2.5 hours until it falls apart. Serve over 300g rice.

w.note: Aniseed cinnamon sugar star cookies, New Mexico's state biscuit
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g sugar and 1 tsp crushed aniseed, then work in 300g flour. Roll out and cut into stars. Dip the tops in sugar mixed with cinnamon and bake at 175C for 10 minutes until pale gold.

d.note: Neat rye whisky with a jug of water
d.how: Pour 45ml rye whisky neat into each of four small glasses. Put a jug of water on the table. Sip slowly while the Regulators plan their next move.

s.note: Wensleydale, cheddar and blue with crackers and chutney
s.how: Take 150g Wensleydale, 150g aged cheddar and 100g blue cheese out of the fridge an hour ahead. Arrange with water crackers, apple slices and a pot of apple chutney. Not a lot of people know that.

s.note: Golden cheese, potato and onion pasties
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar with a finely diced potato and onion. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust into rounds, fill, fold and crimp. Egg wash and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

m.note: Stuffed zucchini with lamb mince and cheese
m.how: Halve 4 large zucchini and scoop out the middles. Fry 500g lamb mince with an onion, a tin of tomatoes and thyme for 15 minutes. Fill the zucchini, cover with 150g grated cheddar and bake at 190C for 35 minutes.

w.note: Walnut carrot cake with cream cheese frosting
w.how: Mix 300g grated carrot, 100g walnuts, 200ml oil, 200g brown sugar, 3 eggs and spice. Fold in 250g self-raising flour and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Frost with 250g cream cheese beaten with 200g icing sugar. Rabbit-proof the kitchen.

d.note: Tea from a warmed pot with digestive biscuits
d.how: Warm a teapot with hot water and tip it out. Add 4 tea bags and 1L boiling water and brew 4 minutes. Pour with milk and sugar and serve a plate of digestive biscuits. Cracking.

s.note: Goat's cheese dates wrapped in prosciutto with honey
s.how: Split 12 medjool dates and stuff each with goat's cheese and a toasted almond. Wrap in half a slice of prosciutto and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Drizzle with honey. These are the good dates, no monkey business.

s.note: Deep brown falafel with tahini sauce and pickles
s.how: Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight. Blitz raw with an onion, 2 garlic cloves, parsley, coriander and 1 tsp cumin. Shape and fry at 175C until deep brown. Thin 4 tbsp tahini with lemon and water for sauce.

m.note: Layered rice, lentils and macaroni with spiced tomato and crisp onions
m.how: Cook 200g rice, 200g brown lentils and 200g macaroni separately. Simmer a tin of tomatoes with garlic, cumin and chilli. Fry 2 sliced onions until crisp. Layer rice, lentils and macaroni, top with sauce, a tin of chickpeas and the onions.

w.note: Coconut semolina cake soaked in lemon rose syrup
w.how: Mix 200g semolina, 80g coconut, 250g Greek yoghurt, 150g sugar and 1 tsp baking powder. Spread in a tin, score into squares and press an almond into each. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes and pour over hot syrup of 150g sugar, water, lemon and rosewater.

d.note: Chilled vodka shots or sweet spiced chai
d.how: Chill a bottle of vodka and pour small shots for anyone game to match Marion. For everyone else, simmer 4 tea bags in 500ml water and 500ml milk with crushed cardamom and sugar, then strain into cups.

s.note: Bright green pea, avocado and mint dip
s.how: Blitz 250g blanched peas with an avocado, mint, the juice of a lemon and 60g feta until bright green. Serve with 4 pita breads cut into wedges and baked at 200C for 8 minutes.

s.note: Lavash with paprika letters stencilled on, and feta dip
s.how: Brush a large lavash with oil. Stencil letters and numbers on with smoked paprika and bake at 180C until crisp. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt to dip. Don't ask it anything.

m.note: Pepperoni mushroom pizza left in the box on the bed
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes and top with 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and 150g sliced mushrooms. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Rewatch the tape.

w.note: Rich baked chocolate custard pots, set and chilled
w.how: Warm 300ml cream and 200ml milk, pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate and stir smooth. Whisk 4 yolks with 60g sugar and combine. Pour into 4 small cups and bake in a water bath at 150C for 30 minutes. Chill until set.

d.note: Strong plunger coffee in big mugs
d.how: Put 60g ground coffee in a plunger with 1L water just off the boil. Steep 4 minutes, plunge and pour into big mugs with milk. Stay awake and keep the camera rolling.

s.note: Double-fried fries in paper cones with sauce
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick fries. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Salt with flaky salt and serve in paper cones with tomato sauce.

s.note: Lime-cured snapper ceviche with sweet potato and corn
s.how: Dice 400g very fresh snapper and cover with the juice of 6 limes for 15 minutes. Add thin red onion, a chopped chilli and coriander. Serve in small cups with cubes of boiled sweet potato and corn kernels.

m.note: Charred spiced chicken with green chilli sauce and fries
m.how: Marinate 1.2kg chicken drumsticks in 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and lime juice. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes until charred. Blitz coriander, a jalapeño, 100g mayo and lime for sauce. Serve with 1kg fries.

w.note: Sparkling clear lemon jelly with grapes and berries
w.how: Soak 6 gelatine sheets. Heat 500ml water with 150g sugar and the juice of 3 lemons and stir in the gelatine. Layer halved green grapes and blueberries in glasses, pour over the jelly and set 4 hours.

d.note: Thick vanilla malt shakes poured tall, fifties diner style
d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk and 1 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into tall glasses. Makes four.

s.note: Jerky, cheddar, crackers and peanuts on the ranch porch
s.how: Set out strips of 100g beef jerky, 250g sharp cheddar cut into chunks, crackers and a big bowl of 200g salted peanuts on the ranch house porch.

s.note: Mini bagels with cream cheese, salmon and capers
s.how: Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread with 150g cream cheese and top with 150g smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill. A little taste of home for the city boys.

m.note: Dried chilli beef and bean chilli with cornbread
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 4 soaked and blitzed dried chillies, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves, a tin of tomatoes and a tin of kidney beans. Braise 3 hours. Serve with a skillet of cornbread.

w.note: Toasted marshmallow and milk chocolate between biscuits
w.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire until blistered. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 digestive biscuits, 100g chocolate and 32 biscuits in all, and press so it melts.

d.note: Boiled campfire coffee poured into tin mugs
d.how: Bring 1.2L water to the boil in a pot and stir in 80g coarse ground coffee. Boil 4 minutes, then splash in a little cold water to settle the grounds. Pour black into tin mugs, carefully.

s.note: Sticky fried sausages in rolls with onions and brown sauce
s.how: Fry 8 pork sausages slowly in a heavy pan until sticky. Fry 2 sliced onions in butter until golden. Put in 8 soft rolls with the onions and a good squirt of brown sauce.

s.note: Sticky honey chilli chorizo with sharp cheddar
s.how: Slice 300g chorizo and fry in a hot pan until crisp. Add 2 tbsp honey and a pinch of chilli flakes and cook until sticky. Spear on toothpicks with cubes of 150g sharp cheddar.

m.note: Rib roast with Yorkshires, honey carrots and red wine gravy
m.how: Roast a 2kg beef rib roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Bake Yorkshires from 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk at 220C. Glaze 4 carrots with honey. Make gravy with 200ml red wine.

w.note: Frosty pavlova with white chocolate and berries
w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour. Bake at 120C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 50g white chocolate shavings and 250g berries dusted with icing sugar.

d.note: Warm spiced apple punch with orange and star anise
d.how: Simmer 1.5L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, orange peel and 2 star anise for 15 minutes. Strain and serve warm in mugs.

s.note: Crisp spiced potato and pea samosas with tamarind
s.how: Cook 500g diced potatoes with 150g peas, 1 tsp cumin, chilli and 1 tsp garam masala. Mix 250g flour with 3 tbsp oil and water into a stiff dough. Roll, cut, shape into cones, fill and fry at 175C until blistered. Serve with tamarind chutney.

s.note: Coiled chilli mango glazed sausages with spiced yoghurt
s.how: Coil 500g chipolatas tightly on a tray, pinning with skewers. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes, brushing with 3 tbsp mango chutney and a chopped chilli. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with cumin to serve alongside. Surprise.

m.note: Slow-braised yoghurt lamb curry with basmati
m.how: Marinate 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder in 200g yoghurt, ginger, garlic and 2 tsp garam masala overnight. Cook 3 sliced onions slowly until deep brown, add a tin of tomatoes, then the lamb. Braise covered at 160C for 2.5 hours. Serve with 300g basmati.

w.note: Mango mousse domes turned out with passionfruit
w.how: Blitz 2 mangoes with 60g sugar. Soak 4 gelatine leaves, dissolve in a little warm purée and stir through. Fold in 250ml whipped cream. Set in 4 dome moulds for 4 hours, turn out and top with passionfruit pulp.

d.note: Frothy cardamom mango lassi to cool down the palace curry
d.how: Blend 2 ripe mangoes with 400g yoghurt, 400ml cold milk, 2 tbsp sugar and a pinch of cardamom until smooth and frothy. Pour into four glasses.

s.note: A pot of tea with plain butter biscuits
s.how: Warm a teapot and brew 4 tea bags in 1L boiling water for 4 minutes. Serve with milk, sugar and a plate of plain shortbread. Very polite, very reassuring, for now.

s.note: Corner store board of cheese, salami, apple and pickles
s.how: Throw together a board with crackers, a 250g block of cheddar, a sliced apple, 100g salami and a jar of dill pickles, like you've just come back from a corner store run. Don't go in the basement.

m.note: Crisp-edged Detroit tray pizza with sauce striped on top
m.how: Press 600g pizza dough into an oiled rectangular tin and prove 30 minutes. Cover right to the edges with 200g cubed mozzarella and 150g cheddar, add 100g pepperoni and bake at 250C for 15 minutes. Stripe tomato sauce simmered with garlic on top.

w.note: Sticky date pudding drowned in hot toffee sauce
w.how: Soak 200g chopped dates in 250ml boiling water with 1 tsp bicarb. Beat 80g butter with 150g brown sugar and 2 eggs, fold in 175g self-raising flour and the dates. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Pour over sauce of 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 200ml cream.

d.note: Red wine in mismatched glasses on the kitchen bench
d.how: Open a 750ml bottle of medium-bodied red on the kitchen bench and let it sit for a few minutes. Pour into whatever two mismatched glasses the rental's cupboard has. Lock the door, and stay upstairs.

s.note: Peanut-spiced beef suya skewers with onion and tomato
s.how: Grind 80g roasted peanuts with 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp ground ginger, chilli flakes and salt. Coat 500g thinly sliced rump and thread onto skewers. Grill hot and serve with sliced red onion and tomato.

s.note: Lunch boxes of apple, cheese, crackers and pretzels
s.how: Pack lunch boxes with slices of 2 red apples, 150g cheddar cubes, water crackers and 100g pretzels. Have them ready to grab before the ship arrives over New York.

m.note: Simple pumpkin, chickpea and spinach stew with flatbread
m.how: Soften an onion with 2 tsp cumin. Add 800g diced pumpkin, 2 tins chickpeas and a tin of tomatoes with 500ml water and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 100g baby spinach and serve with warm flatbread. A simple meal, perfectly balanced.

w.note: Six coloured jelly shots in a row with cream
w.how: Make 4 packets of jelly in different colours, half quantities each, and set in rows of shot glasses. Top each with a little whipped cream. Collect all six.

d.note: Pineapple passionfruit punch with grenadine and soda
d.how: Mix 600ml pineapple juice with the pulp of 3 passionfruit and 40ml grenadine. Pour over ice in four glasses and top with soda water. Wakanda forever.

s.note: Puffy lager-battered onion rings, salted hot
s.how: Cut 3 onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip and fry at 185C until puffed and golden. Salt straight away. Be nice.

s.note: Homemade garlic dill pickles with sharp cheddar
s.how: Pack 500g small cucumbers into a jar with 2 garlic cloves, dill and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over 250ml hot white vinegar boiled with 250ml water and 1 tbsp salt. Pickle a week. Serve with 200g sharp cheddar.

m.note: Sticky molasses barbecue pork ribs glazed under a hot grill
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, garlic and a pinch of cayenne. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Simmer 150ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp molasses, brush on and glaze under the grill.

w.note: Golden syrup pecan pie with cream
w.how: Blind-bake a tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk 3 eggs, 250ml golden syrup, 100g brown sugar, 60g melted butter and vanilla. Stir in 200g toasted pecans, pour in and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Serve with 300ml cream.

d.note: Ice-cold longnecks from a tub, lime if you like
d.how: Bury eight 355ml longnecks of American lager in a tub of ice and water for 30 minutes. Hand them out with a lime wedge for anyone who wants one. Pain don't hurt.

s.note: Seared beef crostini and smoked salmon blinis on black trays
s.how: Sear a 300g eye fillet to rare, rest and slice thin. Toast baguette slices and top with the beef and horseradish cream. Top 12 blinis with crème fraîche, 100g smoked salmon and chives. Serve on black trays.

s.note: Sticky char siu pork belly cubes with pickled cucumber
s.how: Cut 800g pork belly into cubes and toss with 3 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp five spice. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, glazing twice. Quick-pickle a sliced cucumber in rice vinegar. Serve on toothpicks.

m.note: Salmon on crushed potatoes with lemon caper butter and rocket
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and 1 tbsp capers and spoon over. Serve with a peppery rocket salad.

w.note: Chocolate tart dusted half icing sugar, half cocoa
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter into a tart tin. Pour in 250g dark chocolate melted with 250ml cream and set 4 hours. Dust one half with icing sugar and the other with cocoa. Cut down the middle.

d.note: Neat single malt with a jug of water
d.how: Pour 30ml single malt Scotch neat into each of four tumblers. Put a jug of water on the side. Some men just want to watch the world burn, the rest want a quiet drink.

s.note: Golden crab cakes with lemon wedges
s.how: Fold 400g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon and 50g breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Pan-fry in butter until golden and serve with lemon.

s.note: Smoky eggplant dip, hummus and pickles with flatbread
s.how: Char an eggplant whole over a flame until collapsed, then mash with tahini, garlic and lemon. Blitz a tin of chickpeas with tahini for hummus. Serve with pickled turnips and warm flatbreads, sumac dusted over.

m.note: Thick split pea and ham soup with crusty bread
m.how: Simmer 500g split peas with a smoked ham hock, an onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks in 2L water for 2 hours. Pick the ham back in and season. Serve with crusty bread. Eat it, don't throw it.

w.note: Dark devil's food layer cake with fudge frosting
w.how: Whisk 60g cocoa into 250ml hot coffee. Beat 150g butter with 300g sugar and 3 eggs, then add the cocoa, 150ml buttermilk and 250g flour with 1 tsp bicarb. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Cover with 200g chocolate melted with cream.

d.note: Lemon mint sparkling water from little bottles
